title: Inner regularity: a Borel set whose compact subsets in U are all μ-null is μ-null (Simon 1.15; 6, Remark 2.37(1))
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open. Let μ be a measure on ℝ^P with μ(ℝ^P∖U) = 0 and μ(W) < ∞ for every open W ⊂⊂ U. Let E ⊆ ℝ^P be a Borel set such that μ(K) = 0 for every compact K with K ⊆ E and K ⊆ U. Then μ(E) = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U E : Set (Eucl P)) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → μ Uᶜ = 0 → (∀ W, CompactlyContainedOpen W U → μ W < ∞) → MeasurableSet E → (∀ K, IsCompact K → K ⊆ E → K ⊆ U → μ K = 0) → μ E = 0
